description: Erection of a single storey outbuildling to the rear of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([Design and Access Statement], [VD117/PL01],  [VD117/PL02], [VD117/PL03], [VD117/PL04], Received: 10/08/2020, [Arboricultural Impact Assessment], Received: 23/12/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used for the purpose as a play room/store or for any other purpose incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 307 Jersey Road, and not as a self-contained dwelling nor as a business premises, nor shall any kitchen, bathroom, toilet or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
Condition : 4 - The applicant must adhere to the recommendations of the Tree Survey and Arboricultural Impact Assessment received on the 23/12/2020.
